name: Basic Cab
author: superhac
description: The playfield screen shows the selected table's art, full screen and nothing else. Made for cabinets.
change_log: Rebuilt for VPinFE 3.0: core now handles input, audio, preloading, the loading indicator, turning the art for a sideways screen, attract mode and the backglass and score view pages. The theme only draws the playfield art. New option: Playfield Video.
